site.title: Inkrow - Astro Blog Theme
site.description: Inkrow is a clean, modern, and content-focused blog theme for Astro, powered by Strapi CMS. Whether you’re a solo writer, a content team, or an agency building a blog site, Inkrow gives you the perfect structure to share ideas, publish articles, and grow your online presence — beautifully and effortlessly.
